tools.name: Telegram
tools.tagline: Chats and bots · search by meaning · analytics
tools.summary: A Telegram client for the terminal and for AI agents, on your own account.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent read and search your Telegram chats, and send messages when you ask.
signIn.asks: The first time, your phone number and the code Telegram sends, to register your own Telegram app. Then a QR code to scan in Telegram: Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device.

tools.name: MAX
tools.tagline: Chats and bots · search by meaning · analytics
tools.summary: MAX Messenger from the terminal: bots through the official Bot API, and your personal account.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent read and search your MAX chats, and send messages when you ask.
signIn.asks: A QR code to scan with the MAX app on your phone, or a token copied from web.max.ru.

tools.name: WhatsApp
tools.tagline: Chats and bots · search by meaning · analytics
tools.summary: Your WhatsApp account from the terminal, as a linked device, for agents and scripts.

sync.note: WhatsApp has no sync to start. New messages arrive while its background service runs: see Background service below.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent read and search your WhatsApp chats, and send messages when you ask.
signIn.asks: A QR code to scan in WhatsApp: Settings → Linked devices → Link a device. Or your phone number, and a code you type on the phone.

tools.name: Zoom
tools.summary: Keep Zoom transcripts and recordings, search meeting evidence and give your agent context for the next call.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent find your Zoom meetings and read their transcripts and summaries.
signIn.asks: Your browser opens Zoom to approve access. Zoom first needs an app of your own, made once in the Zoom App Marketplace.

tools.name: Google Drive
tools.summary: Import selected Google folders, search documents locally and keep tags, notes and source-backed memories.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent find and read your Google Drive files. It cannot change them.
signIn.asks: Your browser opens Google: choose the account and allow read-only access to Drive.

tools.name: Google Calendar
tools.summary: Copy your Google Calendar events to this computer, search them offline and give your agent the context of each meeting.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent find your calendar events and read them. It cannot change your calendar.
signIn.asks: Your browser opens Google: choose the account and allow read-only access to Calendar.

tools.name: Memo
tools.tagline: Notes, files and Obsidian vaults · search everything
tools.summary: Your notes, files, Obsidian vaults and messages in one place for your AI agent: search, tags, people and memories, on your computer.

tools.name: Email
tools.tagline: Your mailbox over IMAP, searchable on your computer
tools.summary: Gmail, Outlook and other IMAP mail copied to your computer: search it offline, read whole threads, and see how far each sync got. Syncing never changes your mailbox.

mailAgent.name: mail-triage
on: Run memo skill show mail-triage and follow it.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent search and read your mail on this computer. Syncing copies mail here and never changes your mailbox.
signIn.asks: Your mail address, then Microsoft's or Google's sign-in in the browser, or an app password: a password made only for this program, asked in this window.

tools.name: Bitrix24
tools.tagline: Deals, leads, contacts and companies · changes
tools.summary: Read and change a Bitrix24 portal's CRM: deals, leads, contacts and companies, from the Clients page and your agent.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent read and change the portal's CRM with the rights of the employee who made the webhook.
signIn.asks: An incoming webhook address, from Developer resources → Other → Incoming webhook, with the crm, user_basic and department scopes. Or a local application's ID and key, from Developer resources → Other → Local application, signed in in the browser.

tools.name: Asterisk
tools.summary: Import your Asterisk PBX's call records and recordings as meetings, transcribe the calls on this computer and give your agent what was said.

signIn.gives: Lets your agent find your company's phone calls and read what was said in them.
signIn.asks: The path of Master.csv, or the CDR database's address and a read-only user's password.

tools.name: WireCat's Tailscale connection
tools.tagline: A public address for your MCP servers, no password
tools.summary: Joins your Tailscale network as its own device and publishes the MCP servers on this computer through Tailscale Funnel, with no Tailscale app and no administrator password. Tailscale's log upload is off.
